asset.description: The plant or vehicle the diary records. Declared an INTEGER because Assignar's asset_id is numeric where it is populated at all.

content.description: The composed Q&A narrative - the semantic-search payload.

delays.description: Delay reasons and their stated duration.

estimated_completion_date.description: Forecast completion for the linked project.

external_id.description: The source system's own identifier for this diary record; substrate source identity and idempotency key. Declared an INTEGER because that is what the source carries - the identity is a string concept but the adapter does not render it as one.

financial_period.description: The claim/accounting period the diary day falls in.

form_template_id.description: Which form template produced the row. Declared an INTEGER because Assignar's form_id is numeric.

headcount.description: Number of people on site for the day.

hired_plant.description: Hired plant/equipment on site for the day.

incident_reported.description: Whether an incident report was submitted for this day. The diary is evidence, not the incident record.

legal_entity.description: The contracting entity the diary belongs to.

occurred_on.description: The diary's project-day (ISO 8601 date), distinct from when it was filed. One diary is one project-day.

odometer_reading.description: Vehicle odometer at the diary. Unit unverified (km vs miles).

progress.description: What progressed, and where the crew worked.

project.description: The project the diary scopes. Optional because many live diaries carry no linked project. Declared an INTEGER because Assignar's project_id is numeric where populated.

source_modified_at.description: Last modification at source; the incremental harvest cursor.

submitted_at.description: When the form was submitted, distinct from the diary day.

tasks.description: The task(s) selected for the day.

tenant_questions.description: The tenant's own form questions, keyed by the slugified question label. Tenant-specific by construction - the same question does not exist for another tenant.

weather.description: Site weather conditions for the day.

worker.description: The worker who authored / is the subject of the diary. Declared an INTEGER because Assignar's worker_id is numeric.
